citation.authors: Smith RN, Mann NJ, Braue A, Makelainen H et al

cited_by.title: Does diet cause acne? Sugar, dairy and foods linked to spots

record.population: 43 male acne patients aged 15 to 25 in Australia
record.design: Randomised controlled trial, 12 weeks: low-glycaemic-load diet against a carbohydrate-dense control diet
record.finding: Total lesion counts fell more with the low-glycaemic-load diet (-23.5 vs -12.0, P=0.03). Weight and insulin sensitivity also improved more, so the authors say weight loss and diet effects cannot be separated.
record.note: Young men only; not a trial in Black participants; 43 people.
